# spo_tenant_cdn (Resource)

Manages the Office 365 CDN for a type (Public or Private): enabled state and origins (Get/Set-SPOTenantCdnEnabled + Add/Remove-SPOTenantCdnOrigin, CSOM). Keyed by cdn type; adopts the existing config and is not disabled on destroy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spo_tenant_cdn" "public" {
  identity = "Public" # "Public" or "Private"
  enabled  = true
  origins  = ["*/MASTERPAGE", "*/STYLE LIBRARY"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the CDN of this type is enabled.
- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `origins` (Set of String) CDN origins (relative or absolute paths).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
